## Upstream changes 0.12.5 -> 0.13.3

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — database schema migration with a hard no-rolling-upgrade requirement, plus a behavioural default change that can silently break file-aware chats.

### Breaking changes
- **Database Migrations**: "This release includes database schema changes; we strongly recommend backing up your database and all associated data before upgrading in production environments. If you are running a multi-worker, multi-server, or load-balanced deployment, all instances must be updated simultaneously, rolling updates are not supported and will cause application failures due to schema incompatibility." (v0.13.1, Changed) — this compose template runs a single `webui` container, so the multi-instance clause does not apply, but the schema migration itself still runs against the `webui-data` volume on upgrade.
- **Preload files off by default**: "With native function calling, the default, attached files are no longer added to the conversation automatically, and models read them with their file tools instead. Models without tool support or without the Files built-in tool can no longer see attached files until you turn on Preload files in the model's Capabilities." (v0.13.1, Changed) — any model/workflow relying on files being silently injected into context will stop working until Preload files is turned on per model.
- **Retrieval defaults changed**: "Unless you saved your own values, `RAG_TOP_K` and `RAG_TOP_K_RERANKER` now default to 10 instead of 3, and `CHUNK_SIZE` to 1024 instead of 1000." (v0.13.1, Changed) — longer prompts/knowledge context for anyone who never set these explicitly. New chunk size only applies to newly processed files.
- **Side chats are now persisted**: "Side chats, which were always temporary in 0.13.0, are now saved as regular chats and appear in the chat list." (v0.13.1, Changed) — operational/storage/privacy implication if side chats were expected to vanish.
- **Terminal select setting removed**: "The Show Files on Terminal Select setting has been removed from the Interface settings." (v0.13.1, Changed)
- **Always-full-width tabs**: "the full-width toggle added in 0.13.0 is gone" (v0.13.1, Changed) — a UI setting disappears, not a functional break.

None of the above is contradicted by the registry diff, which shows only a build-hash change (see below).

### Variables
- No renamed/removed/newly-required variables found in the notes that apply to this compose file. Notes mention new app-level env vars (`SESSION_EXPIRES_IN`, `RAG_FULL_TEXT_CHAR_THRESHOLD`, `ENABLE_TOOL_CALL_LABELS`, `VIEW_CHAT_MAX_CHARS`) — all are optional, defaulted, and not present in this template's `.env.example`, so nothing to add or edit there.
- Compose/`.env.example` pins (`WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION=0.12.5`, image tag comment) must be bumped to `0.13.3` plus the correct digest — not an upstream-notes item, just the mechanical part of applying this upgrade.

### Data and dependencies
- Irreversible/one-way schema migration on upgrade, per the quoted note above. Single-instance deployment (this template) is not blocked by the rolling-update clause, but the backup recommendation stands.
- No companion-service (database/cache/search engine) version requirement is named anywhere in these notes, so the SAFE-TO-APPLY-blocking rule for an unpinned dependency does not trigger here.
- Already true at 0.12.5, not new in this range: nothing in the 0.12.5 baseline notes states a hard external dependency version; no change there.

### WHAT THE IMAGES THEMSELVES DIFFER IN — verdict
The registry diff shows only `WEBUI_BUILD_HASH` changing between the two image configs. No difference in container user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, or environment defaults. This confirms the compose file's `webui` service block (healthcheck on port 8080, volume mount `/app/backend/data`, `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` env) needs no edits for this upgrade — the running configuration is unaffected at the container level; only the application code and schema inside the image changed.

### Before applying
- Back up `webui-data` (and the `open-webui-backups` volume if used) before upgrading, per the Database Migrations note — this stack's `backups` service already does a live SQLite copy; confirm a recent backup exists before the bump.
- Single-container deployment: stop, swap the image pin, start — no rolling-upgrade coordination needed since there's only one `webui` instance.
- After upgrading, check any model relying on automatic file-context injection; if it uses native function calling and lacks the Files tool, turn on "Preload files" in that model's Capabilities, or confirm Legacy function calling is set if the old implicit behaviour is required.
- Review `RAG_TOP_K`, `RAG_TOP_K_RERANKER`, `CHUNK_SIZE` — if you deliberately never set these, expect longer retrieval context after upgrade; set them explicitly in Admin Settings > Documents if the old values are wanted.
- Update the pin: change `WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION`/`WEBUI_IMAGE_TAG` default in the compose file's `x-images` block (and the `.env.example` comment) from `0.12.5` to `0.13.3` with the new digest.

### Notes read
- v0.13.3, v0.13.2, v0.13.1, v0.13.0 (partial, truncated at the Fixed section) — read in full as provided.
- v0.12.5 — read as baseline only, per instructions; its requirements are not treated as changes in this range.
